comment: Pinned SPICE kernel set, loaded in this order by spiceInterface.addKernelPaths, plus WMM2025.COF for MagneticFieldWMM. The ID is the file stem and is immutable: changing any file needs a new ID. Replaces argus-2026-09-25, whose daily Earth PCK NAIF has deleted (README §8). Runs use measured Earth orientation only: coverage_utc ends at the PCK's last datum, not at its two extrapolated days.

coverage_utc.source: start: pckcov of earth_620120_260806.bpc (1962-01-20T00:00:00 to 2026-08-08T00:00:00 UTC). end and reconstructed_end: its 'UTC Epoch of last datum'. Both reported by scripts/fetch_kernels.py.

kernels.purpose: Leap seconds for UTC <-> ephemeris time (TDB).
JPL DE440 planetary ephemeris (short span, 1849-2150): Sun and Earth positions.

Earth orientation (ITRF93) from measured EOP, 1962-01-20 to 2026-08-06 (last datum), extrapolated to 2026-08-08. NAIF's yearly historical file: superseded versions move to a_old_versions/ and stay there.

IAU_SUN orientation constants (BODY10_*): spiceInterface computes the Sun's orientation for its empty planetFrames entry every step. Basilisk's eclipse radii are hard-coded and never read from this file.

support_files.purpose: World Magnetic Model 2025 coefficients for MagneticFieldWMM (configureWMMFile). Byte-identical to WMM2025COF/WMM2025.COF in NOAA NCEI's https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/sites/default/files/2024-12/WMM2025COF.zip (zip SHA-256 2e76569370d081f2cd7919490218bd094ca9afde347b198eff5621e0af460d03), which fetch_kernels.py cannot unpack; the URLs are Basilisk v2.11.1's own copy and its backup, the file dataFetcher would download.
